text: My God, the soul which Thou hast given me is pure. Thou didst create it, Thou didst form it, Thou didst breathe it into me and preserve it within me. Thou wilt eventually take it from me and restore it to me in the future world. As long as the soul is within me I thank Thee, O Lord my God, and God of my fathers, Lord of all works, Master of all souls. Blessed art Thou, O Lord, who returns souls to dead bodies.
